subject: Post-call: Audit logs & evidence request — FincoBank / Redwood
messages:
From: Erin Sullivan <erin.sullivan@fincobank.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: security@fincobank.com
Date: Thu, 2 Apr 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Audit logs & evidence request — FincoBank / Redwood

Thanks for the call today — useful run-through. A quick recap and follow-ups from our InfoSec team: we need sample audit log exports and a description of the logging schema so our auditors can validate access trails. Specific asks:

- Sample export (CSV or Parquet) that shows: who accessed what resource (user/principal), action (read/write/export), timestamp (UTC), IP address, and any associated request id.
- Retention policy details: default retention window for audit logs, configurable retention, and deletion/archival procedures.
- Evidence that logs are immutable (WORM) or equivalent protections and where backups are stored.
- Data residency: are audit logs stored in-region (US-East) for our account? If not, what are the guarantees for residency and transfer?
- Export procedures and supported formats and tooling for evidence delivery (SFTP, signed CSV, secure Drive link, or direct API).

Can you confirm what you can provide by EOD Monday (4/6)? Also looping Rajiv (backing InfoSec) to confirm required fields.

Thanks — Erin
Erin Sullivan
Director, InfoSec
FincoBank
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Erin Sullivan <erin.sullivan@fincobank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 2 Apr 2026 17:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Audit logs & evidence request — FincoBank / Redwood

Hi Erin — thanks for the clear list and for the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps:  

1) What we'll deliver by EOD Monday (4/6):
   - A sample audit log export (CSV) covering a 7-day window from a staging tenant showing the fields you outlined.
   - A short appendix describing retention defaults, retention configuration options, and the export process.
   - Redacted SOC2 summary and pointer to our compliance artifacts (we'll include the SOC2 summary PDF).

2) Clarifying Qs to make sure the sample meets your auditors' needs:
   - Do you need user email addresses in the principal field, or is a user id/service principal id sufficient?
   - Confirm preferred export format (CSV vs Parquet) and delivery method (SFTP vs secure Drive link).

3) Data residency: our Hosted API stores operational logs in the US for US accounts; we'll confirm the region for audit log exports for your tenant and state that in the appendix. For Dedicated/Private deployments we can guarantee strict in-region storage — happy to cover options if you plan to move to Dedicated.

Action: Marissa, can you attach the CSV sample and SOC2 summary and drop links to the export API? Ben — can you add a short note on immutability/append-only controls and retention SLAs? Neha — please prep a 1-paragraph note on how residency is configured per account.

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Erin Sullivan <erin.sullivan@fincobank.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Audit logs & evidence request — FincoBank / Redwood

Hi Erin — attaching the sample and SOC2 summary as discussed. See inline and attached: 

[attachment: audit_log_sample.csv]  (sample rows from staging tenant, columns: timestamp_utc, principal_id, principal_type, principal_email (redacted), action, resource_path, request_id, ip_address, region)
[attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf]

Inline notes: 
- The sample uses principal_id and principal_type; we included a redacted principal_email column to show mapping possibilities. If you require full emails in the logs for audit, tell us which services/users need that and we can confirm PII policies and data minimization implications.
- Export formats supported: CSV, Parquet. Delivery: SFTP push, pre-authenticated secure Drive link, or direct API pull (token-based).
- Retention: by default audit logs are retained 90 days in hosted; configurable up to 7 years for enterprise customers via Dedicated/Private with archival to encrypted object storage.
- Immutability: logs are append-only in our primary ingestion pipeline; backups are stored across three AZs and we provide SHA256 checksums for exported files to prove integrity. For Dedicated, we can enable WORM via customer-managed object storage.

Link to export API docs (internal): https://internal.redwood.example.com/docs/audit-exports (will share a sanitized public link if you want to hand to auditors).

Next steps: Jonas/Marissa to provide a canonical sample CSV and a short field-mapping document by EOD Monday (4/6). Ben, quick note on immutability?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@fincobank.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Erin Sullivan <erin.sullivan@fincobank.com>, security@fincobank.com
Date: Sun, 5 Apr 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Audit logs & evidence request — FincoBank / Redwood

Thanks — got the sample and SOC2 summary. A couple of follow-ups from our auditors: 

- Please include a short mapping table that explains the principal_id -> principal_email mapping and indicate which fields contain PII. We need to confirm whether storing principal_email violates any of our data-minimization requirements.
- For the export, CSV is fine; please provide a header row and example rows with redacted PII.
- For evidence, can you provide a signed checksum (SHA256) for the exported file and a short statement on the backup retention (where backups are located and for how long)?

- Timeline: auditors want the canonical export + mapping + signed checksum within 30 days. Can Redwood confirm?

If you can acknowledge the 30-day timeline and confirm delivery method (SFTP push preferred), we'll formally open the evidence request ticket.

Rajiv
Senior Security Architect
FincoBank
